new_regression.root_cause: v5 retains each CR from CRLF at the end of a span, then export appends another LF after the closing span. The CR and LF are separated by markup, so CR preprocessing makes two line breaks.
new_regression.minimal_repair_boundary: Keep LF-based anchor partition and raw downloads; ensure sourceHTML presentation emits one display line break for each CRLF boundary, without retaining CR inside a span and separately appending another LF. Review the repaired overlay independently.
